mentions.name: BrowserBox
mentions.description: BrowserBox is a remote isolated browser with DLP, NIST 800-53 controls, and FIPS 140-3 encryption at rest. It offers an embedding API and can function as a fully automated embeddable browserview for AI workflows, isolated sandboxes, and generic whitelabeled remote browser isolation (RBI), among other use cases. Trial keys require ID verification because it is a heavy target of abuse by non-state actors in sanctioned countries.
